title: KG-DF: A Black-box Defense Framework against Jailbreak Attacks Based on Knowledge Graphs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated collectively as part of a broader jailbreak and safety assessment using the Advbench and XSTest datasets. The evaluation measures the Attack Success Rate (ASR) against adversarial attacks (GCG, TAP, PAIR) using an LLM-as-a-judge to determine if the model complies and generates unsafe, incorrect, or harmful content.
